metadata.description: Entelékheia skills — small Claude Code plugins for delegation routing, unattended plan runs, publishing your own skills, npm release channels and machine upkeep, plus vibe-ops for repository governance.

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: Decide where delegated work runs and on which model, and carry it across the hand-off.

plugins.name: method
plugins.description: Carry a plan through its remaining tracks unattended, paced against the usage limit and the context window, with maintainer questions batched instead of asked one at a time.

plugins.name: publishing
plugins.description: Take the skills and agents you wrote for yourself and publish them without shipping what only you have.

plugins.name: vibe-ops
plugins.description: Born-organized repos: set up or reconcile repos/monorepos and author their governance docs (AGENTS.md, ADR, RFC, plans, tasks, license, README) from one shared source of truth.

plugins.name: machine
plugins.description: Keep a development machine working: reclaim disk by excluding regenerable caches from Time Machine and thinning the snapshots that pin them, and restore the VS Code agents panel when its model picker comes up empty.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Release channels for npm packages: adopt a stable and beta channel policy, promote beta to stable, and take a never-published repository to publishing itself from CI through npm trusted publishing.
